about: What check/resource answers for a simplified policy whose only predicate names an undeclared placeholder. x20-undeclared-placeholder records the filter, which denies; the decision on the same policy is recorded nowhere. A filter that denies where check/resource allows is the one shape in which the agent would need to mark such a policy. The agent's converter accepts the policy.

cases.about: The policy of x20-undeclared-placeholder on a resource type of its own. The filter is asked again beside check/resource, the control that the policy is the one x20 records.
